title: My spaces
intro: A space is one own company with its own documents. Every space has its own address and its own sign-in.

create.title: New space
create.name: Name
create.slugHint: 3–30 characters: lowercase letters, digits and dashes (not at the start or end). It cannot be changed later.

unverified: Verify your e-mail before creating a space.
creationDisabled: Creating new spaces is disabled on this instance.

notFound.title: Space not found
notFound.text: There is no space at this address. Check the address or go to the home page.

bootError.title: Server unavailable
bootError.text: The application could not be loaded. Please try again in a moment.

settings.intro: The space name is shown in the application header.

delete.title: Delete space
delete.warning: Deleting irreversibly removes every document, contact, setting, API token and stored file of this space. Tax documents must be archived by law (usually 10 years) – export them before deleting.
delete.exportHint: Download the documents of a period with the accountant export:
delete.confirmSlug: To confirm, type the space address ({slug})

mfa.title: Two-factor authentication
mfa.intro: Applies from the next sign-in: a member without two-factor authentication cannot sign in to this space. Existing sessions and API tokens keep working until they expire or are revoked.
mfa.ownerFirst: Turn on two-factor authentication in your own account first.
mfa.lockedOut: These members do not have two-factor authentication and will be refused at their next sign-in until they turn it on:
mfa.allSet: Every member has two-factor authentication on.
mfa.disableIntro: Members will then be able to sign in without two-factor authentication.
